Moment: she sits sideways on a low curved stone bench, leaning forward to listen into a fixed brass listening cone at shoulder height. Her spine curves naturally; her own right forearm rests on her right thigh and her right hand rests flat on that knee; her own left arm reaches forward and her left palm rests flat on the rim of the cone. Both arms stay in view and connected to their matching shoulders. Both feet rest on the paving.

Outfit: an original adult music-conductor event costume in deep peacock blue: a fitted sleeveless double-lapel waistcoat with a low curved neckline and open crescent waist panels, a short sculpted split peplum attached to opaque tailored shorts, tiny pearl buttons and flat ankle shoes. Bare upper arms, collarbones, side waist and legs; fully opaque fitted fabric and secure chest and pelvis coverage. This is an original event costume, no uniform insignia. Composition: eye-level medium-wide seated composition from her head to her shoes, gentle three-quarter front face, garden paths and the dish visible behind; soft bright late-afternoon daylight.

The bubble floats independently, no creature or other person.
